verdict.rationale: Raygun documents a few programmatic APIs: a Deployments API, plus API-based upload of source maps, dSYMs, ProGuard mapping files and JS files, authenticated with an external access token. Core workflows such as changing error statuses, ignore rules and data export are documented only as dashboard actions, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec, so UI parity is far from shown. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose management API covering error groups, statuses, filters, exports and settings; a published API reference or OpenAPI spec; any evidence that API coverage matches the UI.
